releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.16
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.16**: 5 changes since 0.1.15.

- A glass slider on the onboarding look step (#2258)
- Restore sessions from the command palette (#2284)
- Ssh-only hosts in Rune, pausing a remote, and a clearer missing-credential error (#2279)
- Migrate a remote attach when the network changes or the computer wakes (#2276)
- Bind Rune's shortcuts from [rune.keys] in config.toml (#2269)
